profileNudge.title: Three buildings, no jarl.
profileNudge.body: Name yours from the mark up here and this island follows you to any device. Takes a minute — just a username and password.

motionPrompt.title: Play with animations?
motionPrompt.body: Your device asks for less motion, so menus and the map are held still.

returningLogin.title: Welcome back, {name}
returningLogin.body: Log back in to pick up your realm where you left off.
